5. On 21 November 2025, the Government of India notified four Labour Codes-Code on Wages, 2019; Industrial Relations Code, 2020; Code on Social Security, 2020; and Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020-consolidating 29 existing labour laws. The Ministry of Labour & Employment has published draft Central Rules and FAQs to facilitate assessment of financial impact due to changes in regulations. The Company is in the process of studying the impact of new Labour Codes and continues to monitor the finalisation of Central / State Rules and clarifications from the Government on other aspects of the Labour Code and will provide appropriate accounting effect on the basis of such developments. The impact if any will be identified and provided during Q4 of FY 2025-2026.
